q: How does a Sriperumbudur electronics supplier report Scope 2 to a global brand?
title: Sriperumbudur electronics: Scope 2
short: Report location based Scope 2 from kWh on your bills times 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh (CEA v21.0), and market based Scope 2 only for renewable power you can prove, such as open access contracts or certificates. Brands compare both and check the evidence.
audience: Electronics and component makers in Sriperumbudur and Oragadam supplying global phone and appliance brands

p: All grid kWh times the national factor, plus any diesel generator use in Scope 1.

ul: Open access green power with supplier records.
Renewable energy certificates retired for your site.

p: That the renewable claim matches the kWh and period, and is not also claimed by someone else.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills into dated, fingerprinted records and keeps location based and market based figures side by side, each with the factor and year used.
